title_en: Fall 2026 Course Registration, Including Adjusted Over-Capacity Request Period for ECE Undergraduate Courses
summary: All students registering for Fall 2026 courses must read this notice and its attachments, especially Attachment 1-1, and register within the official period. Over-capacity requests (formerly 초안지) for undergraduate courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering follow an adjusted schedule, so students must check it at the department webpage linked in the notice. The registration dates themselves are not in the notice text; they appear to be in the attachments or an image, which were not read.
applies_to: All students registering for Fall 2026 courses (mandatory: register within the stated period). The adjusted over-capacity request (formerly 초안지) schedule applies only to undergraduate courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기·정보공학부). Over-capacity requests for graduate courses offered by the department follow the university schedule.
conditions: The adjusted over-capacity request schedule applies only to undergraduate courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering.
Over-capacity requests for graduate courses offered by the department follow the university's standard schedule.
Students who do not check the adjusted schedule may be disadvantaged.
Course registration misconduct will lead to cancellation of the course and a disciplinary committee that will impose disciplinary action.
Misconduct includes using a macro to register, using or borrowing the ID of a student on leave of absence or a prospective graduate, and trading courses.
steps: Read all the attachments carefully, and in particular read Attachment 1-1 (Guideline for 2026 Fall Semester Course Registration). These attachments were not read for this translation.
Check the registration schedule and eligibility (Section 1 of the original notice; its details were not in the notice text).

If you need an over-capacity request (정원 외 신청, formerly 초안지) for a department course, read the procedure at https://ece.snu.ac.kr/community/academics?md=v&bbsidx=57915 and confirm the adjusted schedule.
Register for courses within the stated period without using macros, borrowed IDs or course trading.
For questions, contact the department office; the contacts for each topic are listed in the original notice.
translation:
Fall 2026 Course Registration (Including Notice of the Adjusted 'Over-Capacity Request Period' for Undergraduate Courses of the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering)

We announce Fall 2026 course registration as follows. Please read the contents carefully and register within the period.

Since Fall 2023, the schedule for over-capacity requests (정원 외 신청, formerly 초안지) has been adjusted, only for undergraduate courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기·정보공학부). You must check the adjusted schedule so that you are not disadvantaged.
(The over-capacity request period for graduate courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering is the same as the university schedule.)

1. Course registration schedule and eligibility
[The schedule and eligibility details are not in the notice text; they may be in an image or attachment, which was not read.]
※ Procedure for over-capacity (초안지) requests for courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering in Fall 2026
Link: https://ece.snu.ac.kr/community/academics?md=v&bbsidx=57915

2. Detailed information on using the registration site and on course registration: please read the attachments carefully; in particular, you must read Attachment 1-1.
※ Additional information on course registration misconduct
If similar misconduct related to course registration occurs, the department will not only cancel the course but also convene a disciplinary committee and impose disciplinary action.
(*Course registration misconduct includes registering with a macro, using or borrowing the ID of a student on leave of absence or a prospective graduate, and trading courses.)

3. Inquiries (contact details are in the original notice)
- Course registration and changes (over-capacity requests, course withdrawal, overlapping course requests): the department office
- [Undergraduate] Changes to curriculum classification, credit recognition (including online classes), graduation requirements: the department office
- [Graduate] Credit recognition, graduation requirements: the department office
- [Scholarships] Inquiries: the department's undergraduate office

Attachment 1-1. Fall 2026 Course Registration Guideline

Attachment 1-3. Card news on the improved course registration system to prevent course reselling
